name: Cloudflare Computers
description: Run sessions in Cloudflare Sandboxes: containers on Durable Objects that start in under a second and pause to a filesystem snapshot.

provider.label: Cloudflare Sandbox
provider.description: A Linux container on Cloudflare's network, run by a small Worker you deploy to your account. Pauses to a filesystem snapshot and resumes in about a second.

schema.label: Worker URL
schema.description: The URL `npx wrangler deploy` printed for the Worker in this plugin's worker folder, e.g. https://recursive-machines.<you>.workers.dev.

schema.label: Worker token
schema.description: The value you set with `npx wrangler secret put RECURSIVE_TOKEN`. Any long random string.

schema.label: Instance type
schema.description: Container size. standard-2 suits most agents; bigger builds want standard-3 or standard-4.

schema.label: Stop after idle (minutes)
schema.description: Cloudflare stops the container after this long without Recursive checking in (at most 360). Recursive pauses idle computers itself; this is the backstop for when Recursive is asleep or closed.
